thread:
Tara (PM): heads-up: starting a short roadmap sync about variant governance + migration playbook. want clear lanes, migration SLAs, and an ops-safe rollback story before we onboard the next 3 model families
Derek (Eng): ok. do we want a binary fast/full split or more granularity? also how do we express compatibility in the catalog?
Leila (ML): recommend three onboarding lanes: express (quant/4-bit, fast bench), standard (FP16, full bench), certified (enterprise-grade, extended eval + safety checks)
Sam (Ops): three lanes makes sense from infra side. express reduces infra needs but increases branching for routing. need a deterministic fallback rule per tenant
Zoe (CS): customers care about migration guarantees. propose tiered deprecation notice windows: express=120d, standard=180d, certified=270d. also migration credits for certified pinned customers
Tara (PM): good. draft gating criteria idea: express: lightweight smoke + latency/cost checks; standard: full regressions + perf; certified: extended safety, RL eval subset, and legal/compliance review
Leila (ML): concrete thresholds (draft): express: P50 < 140ms, P90 < 700ms, token-cost delta < 20%, core intent pass >= 90%
Leila (ML): standard: P50 < 110ms, P90 < 380ms, hallucination uplift < 1.2% abs, eval pass >= 95%
Leila (ML): certified: P50 < 95ms, P90 < 320ms, hallucination uplift < 0.8% abs, eval pass >= 98% + safety checks
Derek (Eng): routing/fallback mechanics proposal: each model in catalog has a "variantAffinity" block + "fallbackChain". example config snippet: ```json
{"variantAffinity": "stable", "fallbackChain": ["compat-variant-v1","hosted-small"]}
```
Sam (Ops): plus: tenancy lock flag for paid pins so traffic won't auto-route away without explicit customer consent. auto-switchover allowed only for emergency revokes or if customer opts in
Zoe (CS): for sales/enterprise, offer a 12-month paid-long-pin SKU for certified lane customers. include migration assistance (free migration credits) and a custom cutover plan
Tara (PM): deprecation flow suggestion: 1) announce (tiered window) + migration playbook + recommended target variant 2) migrate tooling: tenant migration dashboard + opt-in scheduler 3) soft-redirect after X days (configurable per tier) 4) final retire after notice window
Derek (Eng): rollback criteria during canary: quality regression > 2% on golden set OR latency P90 > SLO by 25% OR error-rate spike > 0.5% absolute. canary cohorts: certified=1%->5%->20%, standard=2%->10%->25%, express=5% cohort only by default
Leila (ML): add automated post-deploy monitoring: drift detector (KL divergence on token distribution + metric regressions). if drift triggers, trigger quick-eval job and pause rollout
Sam (Ops): operations checklist: catalog schema updates (variantAffinity, fallbackChain, lockFlag, pinExpiry, migrationCredits), console UX for tracking pinned tenants, migration dashboard, runbook for emergency revoke
rollout-bot: notice: scheduled canary deploy to staging at 1799123600; CI pipeline -> green required before prod canary
Zoe (CS): I'll draft customer comm templates for each lane and for certified-paid pin offers (90d/60d/30d cadence emails + in-console notices)
Tara (PM): decision points from this thread: approve three lanes, accept draft thresholds, tiered notice windows (120/180/270), paid 12mo certified pin SKU, canary cohort matrix, rollback criteria, catalog schema additions
Tara (PM): owners: Leila finalize thresholds + quick-eval job by Thu EOD, Derek to spec schema + canary orchestration by Mon, Sam to draft ops runbook and console tracking by Mon, Zoe to prepare comms + sales blurb by Wed

Sam (Ops): will add kill-switch. also add audit logs for forced revocations
Leila (ML): I'll prepare small toy eval sets for express lane to keep bench runs < 2h
Tara (PM): sounds good. if no objections I'll put together a 1-pager PRD and create a short ticket set in JIRA. please react if you see anything missing
